PART I

Item 1. Business

This Annual Report on Form 10-K contains forward-looking statements, within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, that involve risks and uncertainties; actual results may differ materially.

Company Background

Synthetic Devices Inc. designs, manufactures and sells laboratory instruments and the software that runs them, and provides related calibration and repair services.

The Company's fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September. The Company was incorporated in Delaware in 1998.

Products

Spectrometers, chromatographs and sample handlers make up most of the Company's net sales; each line is sold with a three-year warranty.

Services
